title: Yub-Nub 1978: Moonwood Space Village
description: A Classic Space launch village woven into living trees: yellow-glazed mission control, a timber Galaxy Explorer, Acorn One, woodland astronauts, climbing stairs and a suspended bridge. Compact forest clearings, overlapping structural boughs, open stair flights, swept wings and curved engine housings preserve the woodland launch scene.
